content: संबुध् €1 <ab>U.</ab> €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To know, understand, learn; become aware of; संभुत्सीष्टाः सुनयनयनैर्विद्विषामीहितानि <ls>Bk. 19. 30</ls>. .²2 To perceive, observe, notice. .²3 To wake up, rise from sleep. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To inform, acquaint with, give information about; तवागतिज्ञं समबोधयन् माम् <ls>R. 13. 25</ls>. .²2 To address, call out to. .²3 To instruct. .²4 To admonish, advise. .²5 To wake up, rouse. .²6 To explain.
